instruction: Speak in Spanish. As you read this, I want your emotion to change. Begin neutrally, then transition to surprise, and finally to joy.
text: Recibí una nota de la oficina central, dice que revise el anexo B. A ver... un momento... ¡No me lo puedo creer! ¡Me han concedido la beca para estudiar en el extranjero el próximo año!

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio entirely fails to convey the requested emotional progression. The delivery is extremely flat and robotic throughout the entire recording, with no audible surprise or joy.

instruction_evidence.emotion_progression: There is no dynamic change in emotion; the delivery is completely static.
instruction_evidence.neutral_to_surprise_to_joy: The voice never transitions to surprise or joy, remaining monotonously neutral (and highly synthetic) from start to finish.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: N/A (Instruction following level is too low)
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: N/A (Instruction following level is too low)

instruction: Speak in Spanish. Deliver this line with a progression of emotions and volume: begin happy and normal, then become worried and quiet, and conclude fearful and very quiet.
text: ¡Qué bien, por fin llegamos a la cabaña! Es un poco más vieja de lo que recordaba, y la puerta está entreabierta. Un momento... creo que hay alguien adentro.

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio completely fails to follow the requested progression of volume and emotion. It maintains a continuous loud, distorted, yelling tone throughout the entire recording instead of transitioning to quiet and very quiet.

instruction_evidence.emotion_progression: There is no progression from happy to worried to fearful; the delivery is uniformly aggressive and synthetic.
instruction_evidence.volume_progression: The volume does not decrease to quiet or very quiet; it remains loud and shouted from beginning to end.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The voice is highly distorted, synthetic, and completely lacks natural human vocal quality.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The expressiveness is extremely poor and monotonous due to the constant shouting.

instruction: Speak in Spanish. Your tone should shift back and forth between sarcastic and complaining. Start sarcastic, then get whiny, and then return to sarcasm.
text: Me encanta trabajar en equipo, es lo mejor. Especialmente cuando soy el único que hace todo el trabajo. Es genial ver cómo los demás se relajan mientras yo paso la noche en vela. Pero claro, el mérito será para todos por igual, ¡qué justo! Ya estoy harto, ¿por qué siempre tengo que cargar con todo? Es increíble que a nadie más le importe.

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio is extremely garbled and unintelligible, failing to convey the Spanish language properly or any of the requested emotional shifts.

instruction_evidence.language: The speech is heavily distorted and barely recognizable as Spanish.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: N/A for level 1. Audio is heavily artifacted and unnatural.

instruction: Speak in Spanish. Start off speaking quietly with a worried tone, but build in volume and intensity, ending in an angry shout.
text: Les expliqué la situación una y otra vez, pero parecía que no me escuchaban. Repetí todos los detalles, les mostré los documentos, y aun así no hicieron nada. ¡Es increíble que después de todo eso, todavía me digan que es mi culpa!

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio completely fails to follow the dynamic progression. It is consistently loud and delivered with severe, harsh synthetic distortion from the very beginning.

instruction_evidence.volume_progression: There is no progression from quiet to loud. The audio starts out loud and remains consistently loud.
instruction_evidence.emotion_progression: There is no worried tone at the start; the entire delivery sounds like a severely distorted, glitchy robotic voice rather than expressing human emotion.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The audio is heavily distorted, robotic, and largely unintelligible.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: Lacks human expressiveness due to extreme synthetic artifacts and lack of intended progression.

instruction: Speak in Spanish. Begin this line in a low-pitched, sad voice. Transition into a more neutral, pensive delivery with a normal pitch by the end.
text: Esa casa ya no está, la demolieron hace años. A veces me pregunto si los lugares guardan los ecos de las risas que una vez contuvieron.

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio successfully demonstrates the requested dynamic shift, starting with a low-pitched and sad tone and clearly transitioning to a normal-pitched, thoughtful delivery in the second half.

instruction_evidence.pitch_progression: The first sentence is spoken in a noticeably lower pitch, which then rises to a normal pitch level for the remainder of the speech.
instruction_evidence.emotion_progression: The delivery begins with a depressed, sad quality and shifts into a more neutral and pensive state as the speaker reflects.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The speech sounds highly synthetic and robotic, with noticeable artifacting and severe phonetic distortions.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: Although the structural shift in emotion is correct, the heavy artificiality of the voice prevents the expression from feeling rich or deeply shaped.

instruction: Speak in Spanish. Your delivery needs three distinct phases. Phase one: quiet, slow, thoughtful. Phase two: a furious climax, very loud and very fast. Phase three: quiet, slow, sad resignation.
text: Uno intenta construir algo, pieza por pieza, con cuidado. ¡Y luego llegas tú y lo destruyes todo en un segundo sin pensarlo! Y yo... me quedo aquí, entre las ruinas.

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio demonstrates some changes in speed and volume across the three phases (faster and louder in the middle, slower and quieter at the ends), but the emotional progression (thoughtful, furious, sad) is completely flattened and missing due to a highly robotic and disjointed delivery.

instruction_evidence.phase_one: The speech is somewhat slower, but lacks the requested 'quiet' and 'thoughtful' emotional tone.
instruction_evidence.phase_two: The speed and volume noticeably increase, but it lacks a true 'furious climax' and sounds mechanically sped up.
instruction_evidence.phase_three: The speech slows down and volume decreases, but there is no perceptible 'sad resignation'.

instruction: Speak in Spanish. I want you to begin with an unnaturally high-pitched voice, then transition smoothly down to your normal vocal range by the end of the sentence.
text: ¡Ay, qué susto! Pensé que algo malo había pasado. Pero no, ya veo que estás bien. Menos mal. Vamos a sentarnos un momento, y me cuentas qué ha sucedido con tranquilidad.

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The pitch does drop from high to low across the audio, but the transition is blocky rather than smooth, and severe synthetic artifacts make the final 'normal vocal range' sound highly robotic.

instruction_evidence.pitch_start: The audio starts with an unnaturally high pitch as requested.
instruction_evidence.pitch_progression: The pitch lowers progressively across the sentences, but the transition lacks smoothness and the voice remains heavily distorted throughout.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The speech is completely unnatural, suffering from severe synthetic glitches, robotic artifacts, and extremely poor pronunciation.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The robotic delivery and heavy distortion prevent any appropriate expressive variation.

instruction: Speak in Spanish. Begin this line in a very slow, very quiet manner. As you speak, build to a normal volume and speed, as if a thought is solidifying in your mind.

instruction_evidence.speed: The speech rate is relatively constant and monotonous throughout the utterance; it does not start very slow nor build up speed.
instruction_evidence.volume: The volume starts at a normal level and remains constant, completely ignoring the instruction to begin very quiet and increase.

instruction_evidence.tone_progression: There is no transition from a pleading tone to a strong, defiant tone; the delivery is entirely monotonous.
instruction_evidence.speed_progression: The speaking rate remains constant throughout the recording instead of starting slowly and getting faster.
